semantics.behavior: Purely combinational: out[7:0] equals in and each bit out[31:8] equals in[7].
semantics.timing: No clock or cycle latency; output follows input after combinational settling.
semantics.reset: No reset port or reset behavior.
semantics.initialization: No internal state or initialization required.
semantics.handshake: None; all input bit patterns are legal.

numeric.output_interpretation: Same value represented in 32-bit two's complement.
numeric.operation: Concatenate 24 copies of in[7] followed by in[7:0].
numeric.rounding_truncation_overflow: None; extension preserves every input bit and signed value.

verification.plan: Independent self-checking simulation of all 256 binary input patterns. Compute expected signed integer as input value for 0..127, or input value minus 256 for 128..255, then compare its 32-bit representation against out.
verification.timing: Drive each input and allow one simulation time unit to settle before checking.
verification.tools: Icarus Verilog v12 with -g2012 and explicit dev_tb top; matching vvp; finite external timeouts.
verification.static_review: Check exact ports, widths, continuous combinational assignment, no state and synthesizable source.
